newsitem.title: USA: ComEd sees Dresden 2 nuke at 100 pct Weds.
newsitem.headline: ComEd sees Dresden 2 nuke at 100 pct Weds.

text.p: Commonwealth Edison Co's 794 megawatt (MW) Dresden 2 nuclear power unit, in Morris, Illinois, will likely return to full power on Wednesday, a company spokesman said Tuesday.
"The turbine control valve has been repaired, and we should begin testing this evening. It should return to full power over the holiday," he said.
The unit has been operating at about 40 percent power for about a week.
Dresden 3, with the same generating capacity, is scheduled to return to service January 13 after being shut October 26 for maintenance.
Also, ComEd's 1,040 MW Zion 2 nuclear unit in Zion, Ill., shut September 18 for scheduled maintenance, will likely return to full power later this week, he said.
ComEd is a subsidiary of Unicom Corp.
